Implements adminEditUserProfile (CT-24p) and removes its planned mark: phone normalised, blocklist 44001 before occupancy 30411 (44001 is a back-office refusal: no risk_hits, no data), saved immediately without verifying the new number, all sessions and refresh tokens revoked with push-token unbinding, old phone_hmac written to deleted_identities (phone_changed, 180 days; skipped when the user had no phone); nickname reuses the content review and does not count against the monthly limit; reason required; phone, nickname and audit in one transaction, user row locked FOR UPDATE with checks re-run under the lock.
